turns.content: Explain how 5,6-bis(dibromomethyl)cyclohexa-1,3-diene and sodium iodide generate the reactive annulation equivalent used in the sequence.
With two equivalents of that species, describe the framework formed from both double bonds of 7-(tert-butoxy)bicyclo[2.2.1]hepta-2,5-diene.
Describe the deprotection caused by aqueous sulfuric acid and the functional group present in product 2.
Describe the SO3-pyridine/DMSO oxidation that converts product 2 into product 3.
Explain how the framework established in the preceding stages undergoes final aromatization under the stated conditions.
Use the final acene framework established above and its molecular symmetry to count its chemically distinct proton environments.
Group the peripheral hydrogens into symmetry-equivalent sets and verify the count.
Report the final number of distinct proton environments and summarize the symmetry rationale.
